Returns sites, unreviewed grid area, and a count range. low counts sites at or above the higher of the
threshold and the 75th percentile of kept scores; high counts all sites. scored_cells: [{cell_id, score}].
tools.name: aggregate

tools.description:
Build (or reuse) a grid of embedding cells for a source, cell size (m) and year over aoi_bbox (default:
the task AOI). Returns an index_id, the cell count and provenance. Only allow-listed sources.
tools.name: build_index

tools.description:
Score cells in [0, 1] with a classifier trained on example cells vs random cells (fixed seed).
method linear_probe (logistic regression), linear_svm (sigmoid of the margin) or vision_subagent (may be
not configured). cell_ids defaults to every cell; example_ids defaults to all training examples.
tools.name: classify

tools.description:
Up to n permitted few-shot positive examples (id, lon, lat) from the training split. Other splits are
refused. May return none when the area has no labelled examples.
tools.name: get_examples

tools.description:
Read a square window of side_m metres centred on lon/lat from a scene, resampled to out_px x out_px.
        effective_gsd_m = max(side_m / out_px, pixel_spacing_m) is the detail you actually see (upsampling
        adds none); the image follows the metadata.
tools.name: imagery_window
